titulo_fr: Une annonce de formation : Repérer les informations
intro: Locates requirements, dates and modality in a course announcement. Read the French first; open the translation when you want to check your understanding.

texto: Locates requirements, dates and modality in a course announcement. It relates the matter to the request and checks the dates, conditions and actions that the message asks to perform.
Attention: « Il faut » expresses a requirement; « avoir lieu » indicates where or when something is celebrated. In this fragment, «formation» means «Training».

frases.es: El centro ofrece un curso de fotografía para adultos principiantes.
frases.en: The center offers a photography course for beginners.

frases.fr: Les cours ont lieu le mardi soir, du 3 novembre au 15 décembre.
frases.es: Las clases tienen lugar los martes por la tarde, del 3 de noviembre al 15 de diciembre.
frases.en: The classes take place on Tuesday afternoon, from 3 November to 15 December.
